title: Rationalization of integral fibre paths
statement: For any linear path family on the integral fibre functor over E, there exists a linear path family on the actual rational fibre functor. Its component sends a tensor x to a tensor of the integral path of x, through exactly the prescribed rational object equalities. This evaluation formula determines the family uniquely, and fixes identity, composition, conjugation and change of path. Definitions and hypotheses are those of [new-e5-fibre-path-transport-data], [def-pod-lisse-adic-fibre-functors].

source.place: Weil II (1.1.1) b)-d), pp.146-147; explicit part of the fibre transport argument

proof.text: Conjugate the scalar extension of each integral path by the rational fibre object equalities. For a rational morphism clear its denominator in the rationalized Hom module, apply integral naturality, then cancel the nonzero denominator. This proves naturality without choosing a lattice for the morphism.

Pure tensors generate the scalar-extended fibres. Evaluation therefore proves all four path laws and uniqueness. Choose the uniquely characterized family and expose its component and pure-tensor formulas.

lean.statement:
theorem rationalFibrePathFamily_apply
    (d : LinearFibrePathFamily Y (LisseIntegralSheaf l E Y)
      (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)
      (fun y ↦ lisseIntegralFiberFunctor l E Y y))
    {Ωy : Type u} [Field Ωy] [IsAlgClosed Ωy] (y : Spec (.of Ωy) ⟶ Y)
    {Ωz : Type u} [Field Ωz] [IsAlgClosed Ωz] (z : Spec (.of Ωz) ⟶ Y)
    (t : flcFiber y ≅ flcFiber z) (F : LisseRationalSheaf l E Y) (a : E)
    (x : (lisseIntegralFiberFunctor l E Y y).obj F.integral) :
    ((rationalFibrePathFamily l E Y d).map y z t).hom.app F
      (eqToHom (lisseRationalFiberFunctor_obj l E Y y F).symm (a ⊗ₜ[_] x)) =
        eqToHom (lisseRationalFiberFunctor_obj l E Y z F).symm
          (a ⊗ₜ[_] ((d.map y z t).hom.app F.integral x))
